answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 156 identities means 156 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the knoll pair is tracked in the horizon ledger, the fable audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 49%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
